title: Kyoto Fusioneering starts work on key fusion power plant device
summary: Breeding blankets harvest energy from the fusion reactor while also generating fresh fusion fuel. Kyoto Fusioneering is also developing systems to heat fusion fuel into a plasma, recycle unburned fuel from the exhaust, and harvest heat to generate electricity.
